body:
The AgGrid export jobs exposed by #249 fail on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 with the same error: the formatter demo bundles `$/utils/components`, while Reflex now generates `row_counter` in `$/app_components/ag_grid/formatters`.

Bundle a `row_counter` prototype during page creation so Reflex registers the actual generated module after compiler resets. This also supports Reflex 0.9.6, whose compiler clears import-time registrations. Annotate the argument as `rx.Var[str]` to match the current memo API. This fixes inline, state-backed, and API-supplied column definitions without depending on a hard-coded output path.

Run the regression probe in a fresh interpreter so demo state/page registrations cannot affect other unit tests. Exercise the formatter page directly, without its navigation/source viewer wrapper, to keep the probe independent of the platform's text encoding.

Validation:
- Reproduced the original export failure on Reflex 0.9.12 / Python 3.13.
- Full production exports succeed on Reflex 0.9.6 and current Reflex main (`e080fbf8cc66268f5c15c2fb44f7177465c001f8`); frontend and backend archives are nonempty and pass ZIP integrity checks. The initial fix was also verified with a full export on Reflex 0.9.12.
- Headless Chromium verifies the memoized renderer in the Inline, State, and API tabs with no JavaScript errors.
- All 16 AgGrid and Var unit tests pass on Reflex 0.9.6, 0.9.12, and main, including a regression test for bundle registration after a compiler reset.
- Full local unit suites pass on Reflex 0.9.6, 0.9.9, and 0.9.12: 1,177 passed and 3 skipped on each.
- CI unit matrix passes on all four Linux and all four Windows Python versions, plus Reflex 0.9.6, 0.9.9, and main.
- Repository pre-commit hooks pass.

Separate from #249; no CI workflow changes.
title: fix: bundle AgGrid demo memoized cell renderer
